what: The daemon asked SystemTime at every racy question while the simulated disk stamped mtimes from a counter starting at 1, so in every simulation no stamp was ever racy: no column name was saved unknown and the slot writer's read of one (what Plant::SlotBeforeLook breaks) was unreachable; solo.rs's control was #[ignore]d for it.
cost: a control that could not run; every racy-window path of the daemon untested under simulation
cause: the daemon read a clock of its own (certify::wall_ns) instead of its driver's, so the simulation could not inject it
class: a core reading an ambient clock beside the injected one
prevention: Driver::wall_ns is the one wall clock of a loop; World carries it; heads' arrive/complete take it; the sim's disk stamps by it (wall start + virtual now). Real-disk stamps outside a driver (premises, the tool cache) say they use blaze_core::system_wall_ns
fix: Driver::wall_ns on every driver; certify::wall_ns deleted; solo.rs's the_oracle_catches_a_slot_written_before_its_look un-ignored
